market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor political figure with no major national base. Even if he runs, the top two spots will almost certainly be occupied by well-known contenders like Lula and a leading opposition candidate (e.g., Tarcísio de Freitas). The probability of him finishing second is negligible, well below the 7.3% implied.
evidence_points: Recent 2026 election polls consistently show Lula and Tarcísio de Freitas as the frontrunners.
PSOL has historically not mounted competitive presidential bids; its best-known figure Guilherme Boulos received ~1% in 2018.
No scenario of fracture on the left or right plausibly lifts an unknown candidate to second place in a polarized Brazilian election.
